lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੁਜ ਬਲ ਬੀਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਗਰਤ ਪਰਤ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਅੰਗੁਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhuj bal beer braham sukh saagar garat parat gahi lehu a(n)gureeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O Brave and Powerful God, Ocean of Peace, I fell into the pit - please, take my hand. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਨਿ ਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨੈਨ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਹੀ ਆਰਤ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਰਟਤ ਪਿੰਗੁਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sravan na surat nain su(n)dar nahee aarat duaar ratat pi(n)gureeaa ||1||
lines.translation: My ears do not hear, and my eyes are not beautiful. I am in such pain; I am a poor cripple, crying at Your Door. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਹਤਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: deenaa naath anaath karunaa mai saajan meet pitaa mahatareeaa ||
lines.translation: O Master of the poor and helpless, O Embodiment of Compassion, You are my Friend and Intimate, my Father and Mother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਵਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਆ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: charan kaval hiradai gahi naanak bhai saagar sa(n)t paar utareeaa ||2||2||115||
lines.translation: Nanak holds tight to the Lord's Lotus Feet in his heart; thus the Saints cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||2||115||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Raag Gauree Bairaagan, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਯ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਮੀਤੁਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਬਾਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: day gusaaee meetulaa too(n) sa(n)g hamaarai baas jeeu ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord God, my Best Friend, please, abide with me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਰੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਨਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਰਹਣਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tujh bin gharee na jeevanaa dhrig rahanaa sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: Without You, I cannot live, even for an instant, and my life in this world is cursed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਿਆ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਜੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jee praan sukhadaatiaa nimakh nimakh balihaar jee ||1||
lines.translation: O Breath of Life of the soul, O Giver of peace, each and every instant I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਸਤ ਅਲੰਬਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਰਤਹੁ ਉਧਰੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: hasat ala(n)ban dehu prabh garatahu udhar gopaal ||
lines.translation: Please, God, give me the Support of Your Hand; lift me up and pull me out of this pit, O Lord of the World.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਮਤਿ ਥੋਰੀਆ ਤੂੰ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mohi niragun mat thoreeaa too(n) sad hee deen daiaal ||2||
lines.translation: I am worthless, with such a shallow intellect; You are always Merciful to the meek. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਤੇਰੇ ਸੰਮਲਾ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧੀ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa sukh tere sa(n)malaa kavan bidhee beechaar ||
lines.translation: What comforts of Yours can I dwell upon? How can I contemplate You?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਦਾਸ ਹਿਤ ਊਚੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saran samaaee daas hit ooche agam apaar ||3||
lines.translation: You lovingly absorb Your slaves into Your Sanctuary, O Lofty, Inaccessible and Infinite Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਾਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal padaarath asat sidh naam mahaa ras maahi ||
lines.translation: All wealth, and the eight miraculous spiritual powers are in the supremely sublime essence of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਕੇਸਵਾ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: suprasa(n)n bhae kesavaa se jan har gun gaahi ||4||
lines.translation: Those humble beings, with whom the beautifully-haired Lord is thoroughly pleased, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪੋ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: maat pitaa sut ba(n)dhapo too(n) mere praan adhaar ||
lines.translation: You are my mother, father, son and relative; You are the Support of the breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਜੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g naanak bhajai bikh tariaa sa(n)saar ||5||1||116||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak meditates on the Lord, and swims across the poisonous world-ocean. ||5||1||116||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਰਹੋਏ ਕੇ ਛੰਤ ਕੇ ਘਰਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee bairaagan rahoe ke chha(n)t ke ghar mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Bairaagan, Chhants Of Rehoay, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hai koee raam piaaro gaavai ||
lines.translation: Is there anyone who will sing of the Beloved Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸੂਖ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab kaliaan sookh sach paavai || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Surely, this will bring all pleasures and comforts. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ban ban khojat phirat bairaagee ||
lines.translation: The renunciate goes out into the woods, searching for Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਲੇ ਕਾਹੂ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: birale kaahoo ek liv laagee ||
lines.translation: But those who embrace love for the One Lord are very rare.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jin har paaiaa se vadabhaagee ||1||
lines.translation: Those who find the Lord are very fortunate and blessed. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਚਾਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: brahamaadik sanakaadik chaahai ||
lines.translation: The Gods like Brahma and Sanak yearn for Him;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਸਿਧ ਹਰਿ ਆਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jogee jatee sidh har aahai ||
lines.translation: the Yogis, celibates and Siddhas yearn for the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jisahi paraapat so har gun gaahai ||2||
lines.translation: One who is so blessed, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਜਿਨ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kee saran jin bisarat naahee ||
lines.translation: I seek the Sanctuary of those who have not forgotten Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaagee har sa(n)t milaahee ||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, one meets the Lord's Saint.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤਿਹ ਮੂਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran tih moole naahee ||3||
lines.translation: They are not subject to the cycle of birth and death. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮਿਲੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa mil preetam piaare ||
lines.translation: Show Your Mercy, and lead me to meet You, O my Darling Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: binau sunahu prabh ooch apaare ||
lines.translation: Hear my prayer, O Lofty and Infinite God;

lines.transliteration: naanak maa(n)gat naam adhaare ||4||1||117||
lines.translation: Nanak begs for the Support of Your Name. ||4||1||117||
